title: One Web Mercator cell of aggregated crowdsourced depth soundings
description: Depths are positive-down metres below the chart datum named by the set's verdat (csb-cell-set.json); a negative depth dries. A cell exists only where at least one accepted sounding lies in it: nothing is interpolated. dMin <= dShoal <= dMedian and tFirst <= tLast.

quadkey.description: Web Mercator tile key of the cell; its length is the zoom.

dMin.description: Shallowest reduced sounding; at a coarser zoom, the minimum of the children's dMin.

dShoal.description: The set's shoalQuantile of the reduced soundings; at a coarser zoom, the minimum of the children's dShoal.

dMedian.description: Median of the reduced soundings. Leaf zoom only.

spread.description: Sample standard deviation of the reduced soundings, metres. Leaf zoom only.

sigmaZ.description: 1 sigma vertical uncertainty of one reduced sounding (sounder, vessel offsets, water-level reduction), metres; at a coarser zoom, the largest of the children's.

sigmaXY.description: 1 sigma horizontal uncertainty of one sounding position, metres; at a coarser zoom, the largest of the children's.

nPlatforms.description: Distinct platforms (IHO CSB UNIQUE_ID) behind the soundings, counted from the soundings at every zoom.

nDays.description: Distinct UTC dates with soundings, counted from the soundings at every zoom.

reduction.description: The weakest water-level reduction applied to any sounding in the cell, best first: gauge (observed water level), model (tide or surge model), none (depth below the surface at the time of the sounding, not on the set's datum).

ref.description: The least known depth reference of any sounding in the cell before reduction, best first: surface (transducer depth added), transducer, unknown. transducer and unknown read shallower than the depth below the surface.

providers.description: IHO CSB trusted nodes (PROVIDER) behind the soundings. In a vector tile, one string with the names joined by commas.
